切尔西在本赛季六场比赛中有五场在比赛前十分钟取得进球。哈维·阿隆索表示这些闪电战与他无关，但在5-1大胜伯恩茅斯后，摩根·罗杰斯持有不同的观点。“我把它归功于主教练的赛前训话，”罗杰斯说。“他让我们充满斗志，让我们兴奋起来。我们总是希望从一开始就占据主动。关键在于开局要好并取得领先。很多比赛，尤其是在主场，我们在抓住开局进球后赢得了比赛——这是一个很好的特质。我们需要继续保持。”雅各布·斯坦伯格
比赛报告：切尔西 5-1 伯恩茅斯

主场战绩一直是乌奈·埃梅里取得非凡成功的基础，但本赛季在维拉公园球场的胜利却迟迟未能到来。当然，现在还为时尚早，周三主场对阵费内巴切的欧冠赛程为他们提供了另一个打破进球荒的机会——但埃梅里深知主场作为堡垒的价值。本赛季球场的视觉效果有所不同，北看台正在重建，球场容量将超过5万人。一个三面看台的球场会产生影响吗。“我作为球员时肯定讨厌它，”保持不败战绩的布伦特福德主教练基思·安德鲁斯说。“这感觉不对，不是吗？当我还是个孩子的时候，一些爱尔兰传奇人物曾在这里效力——雷·霍顿、保罗·麦格拉思、安迪·汤森——所以这里对我来说一直是一个特殊的地方，你能感受到它的历史。少了一个看台，感觉有点不同。”本·费舍尔
比赛报告：维拉 2-2 布伦特福德

踢了六场比赛的伊普斯维奇在保级所需积分的进度上遥遥领先。现代英超的“补锅匠”加里·奥尼尔给这支“拖拉机男孩”带来了一种坚韧，而这正是两年前基兰·麦肯纳带领他们升入英超所欠缺的。这位伊普斯维奇新帅也同样冷酷无情。在战胜水晶宫后，夏窗签约的谢尔彭被弃用，取而代之的是知根知底的克里斯·沃尔顿，虽然这并未能锁定联赛首场零封，但这名老门将确实显得更加沉稳。丢球数会让奥尼尔感到担忧——联赛中只有两支球队的丢球数更多——但他的球队的体能令人欣慰。伊普斯维奇现在已经三次在90分钟后打入制胜球。这不是一个可持续的策略，但它表明这支球队具备战斗精神。TB
比赛报告：伊普斯维奇 2-1 富勒姆

桑德兰在夏季转会市场的首要任务据称是引进一名正牌右边锋。最终他们未能签下这样一名球员，这可以说让雷吉斯·勒布里的球队付出了沉重的代价。周六主场迎战表现出色的布莱顿，他们以两名纯正的右后卫首发，其中第二人托马斯·穆尼耶在更靠前的位置活动。当并不逊色的穆尼耶拉伤大腿后，勤勉但低效的尼尔森·安古洛被从他偏爱的左路调到右路。由于缺少了大腿拉伤的中锋布赖恩·布罗贝伊，桑德兰的十一人阵容未能构成威胁。勒布里难道不是时候在下周日对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中给天赋异禀但目前被忽视的克里斯·里格或切姆斯丁·塔尔比首发机会了吗？在此之前，桑德兰将于周四前往葡萄牙对阵托雷恩斯。在仅仅拿到四个英超积分后，勒布里很可能会在这场欧联杯比赛中进行大面积轮换。在客场对阵伯恩茅斯之后，紧接着是客场对阵波兹南莱赫以及主场迎战利兹联的比赛，他的任务看起来十分棘手。露易丝·泰勒
比赛报告：桑德兰 0-2 布莱顿

items.titleEn: Arsenal 2-1 Leeds: Premier League – as it happened
items.summaryEn: The reigning champions were forced to dig extremely deep to come from behind and beat visitors who can go home with their heads held extremely highRead Paul MacInnes’s match report from the Emirates StadiumAn email: “Happy Saturday, Barry,” writes Mark Kerry. “Is it just me or are there other baffled Arsenal fans out there regarding Arteta’s obsession with starting Havertz as a centre forward? I just can’t see the rationale for it at this point, given that Havertz has proven over the last few seasons that he’s not at all prolific, whereas Gyokeres is clearly a capable finisher - as exemplified both by last season in the Premier League but also during recent internationals. Would Arsenal not be better to persist with, or even adapt to,a more natural goal scorer?”I’m not an Arsenal fan, baffled or otherwise, but I don’t think Gyokeres is a good enough centre-forward to play for them and I’
bodyEn: “Before the game we talked about two things,” says Arsenal’s manager in a chat with TNT Sports. “One: the challenge ahead because Leeds had not lost in the Premier League and it was going to be really tough. And second: to restore our identity and be ourselves again, regardless of the context of the match. We weren’t pleased against Brighton and today was an opportunity to put that right. We certainly reacted in the manner we expected.”

On Arsenal’s game-changing equaliser: “When you play 12:30 at home and you go 1-0 down, you have to restore a lot of things. The energy is one of them. We had an incredible response. You could sense the crowd, the energy changed immediately. The finishers come in and made a huge difference to help us win the game.”
Arsenal: The Gunners host French side Lille in the Champions League on Tuesday night before travelling to the City Ground to play Nottingham Forest next Sunday.

Leeds United: Following their first Premier League defeat of the season, Daniel Farke’s side have more than a week to dust themselves down before hosting Manchester United in what ought to be a spicy encounter at Elland Road next Sunday.

“It feels unbelievable,” says the Brazilian, in an interview with TNT Sports. “I felt in the last game against Brighton we were not at the level. Today the mentality was bouncing back. This is my first official game at home. It feels unbelievable to score and it’s an important goal, three important points. It was a great finish and I am very happy.”

Upon being asked if he feels he has a point to prove to Mikel Arteta he says. “I want to give him a little headache but I have been proving myself in the Premier League for the past five years. This is a new challenge for me and its always important to play. The most important thing for Bruno is to go to the pitch and play the best football, I am very happy with that today.”

Premier League match report: Arsenal were not great against Leeds but showed impressive resilience to come back from a goal down, defeat strong opponents and reset their form after a lengthy international break. Paul MacInnes reports from the Emirates Stadium …
Saturday clockwatch: Sarah Rendall is here to bring you news of all the goals as they go in and any other major talking points from today’s four three o’clock kick-offs …

Peep! Peep! Peeeeeeeeeeeeeeeep! A terrific game of football draws to a close at the Emirates Stadium, where Arsenal had to dig extremely deep to come from behind and see off a mightily impressive Leeds side.

James Justin opened the scoring for the visitors with a tidy finish on 55 minutes and their lead was no more than they deserved after an excellent but fruitless first half. Arsenal equalised through Riccardo Calafiori seven minutes later and from that point on it was all one-way traffic.

Arsenal’s winner was a wonderful team goal in which Bruno Guimaraes played the starring role, beginning the move before ending it with a wonderful low drive. Arsenal were made to work extremely hard for their win by a Leeds side who can go home with their heads held high.

90+5 min: Gyokeres plays Saka in behind the Leeds defence and he’s clear on goal with only Trafford to beat. The Leeds goalkeeper does enough to force the Arsenal winger to shoot wide. It’s the final kick of the game and the referee blows for full time.
90+5 min: Gudmondsson sends a cross into the Arsenal box from the left. Gabriel heads it clear.
90+4 min: Leeds throw-in and Ethan Ampadu trebuchets the ball into the Arsenal penalty area. It’s headed clear.

90+2 min: With Trafford stranded in no-man’s land after a rush of blood to the head, Viktor Gyokeres passes up at least one opportunity to score into an empty goal from distance while apparently trying to walk the ball into the net from 30 yards out. What are you doing?!
90+1 min: We’re into five minutes of added time. Can Leeds snatch the point they almost certainly deserve from this match?
90 min: Arsenal substitution: Mikel Merino on for Odegaard, who’s been instrumental in helping Arsenal to restore parity and get what looks like being their winner.
89 min: A Dominic Calvert-Lewin cross into the box ricochets off Jurrien Timber but doesn’t quite break for Aaronson.

87 min: Since Arsenal equalised, Leeds seem to have run out of both energy and ideas. They’d played superbly for the opening 65 minutes but Arsenal have shown great strength in the face of extreme adversity.
85 min: Leeds double-substitution: Jean Matteo Bahoya and Jaka Bijol on or Bogle and Elvedi.

82 min: Jurrien Timber swings a cross to the far post, where Declan Rice takes it down, sells Jayden Bogle a dummy and drills the ball into the six-yard box. It’s blocked by Muharemovic but only on to the shins of Odegaard. Somehow, he fails to score and a shot he didn’t know much about is saved by Trafford. That’s a real let-off for Leeds after a wonderful soft-shoe shuffle in tight space from Rice. Who knew he had that in his locker?
81 min: Arsenal substitution: Piero Hincapie on for Riccardo Calafiori.
80 min: Leeds substitution: Farke sends on Lukas Nmecha for James Justin and his side switches from a back five to a 4-4-2.

78 min: Declan Rice heads a free-kick into the Arsenal box away, then leaps to head the return ball clear. Arsenal attempt to break upfield but James Justin takes a yellow card for his team by dragging Bruno back.
76 min: Leeds double-substitution from a couple of minutes ago: Harry Wilson and Brenden Aaronson on for Tanaka and Okafor, who have both been terrific.
75 min: Arsenal surge forward in numbers with Saka on the ball. Despite the support, he goes it alone and shoots over the bar.

72 min: Bruno started and finished that goal from a quickly taken free-kick. The ball was pinged down the left, zipping from Saka inside to Odegaard and on to Rice, who sent it into the path of the goalscorer with an audacious flick of his heel.

Arsenal lead! It’s a lovely team move involving – among others – Saka, Odegaard and Rice in the build-up before Bruno Guimaraes smashed a low shot into the bottom corner from the edge of the penalty area.

67 min: Arsenal have momentarily seized control of the game since equalising and ringing the changes. The ball breaks to Calafiori on the edge of the area when a cross is blocked his way by Calvert-Lewin. The Italian’s shot is wild and he fails to get near the target.
64 min: Arsenal triple-substitution: Jurrien Timber, Bruno Guimaraes and Viktor Gyokeres on for White, Lewis-Skelly and Havertz.

Arsenal equalise! A Madueke cross from the left to the far post is headed back into the Leeds penalty area from the byline by Ben White. In acres of space, Calafiori leaps like a Victorian scullery maid who’s just seen a mouse and sends a dainty volley past Trafford. The Leeds goalkeeper got a hand to it but couldn’t keep the shot out.

61 min: Leeds play out from the back and through the middle of Arsenal as Martin Odegaard gesticulates like a traffic policeman on amphetamines at rush hour as he tries to get assorted Arsenal teammates to close their opposite numbers down.
59 min: Arsenal win a free-kick in a promising position but Martin Odegaard sends his delivery straight into the gloves of James Trafford.

58 min: Jayden Bogle curls a wonderful low cross through the Arsenal penalty area after brilliant hold-up play from Dominic Calvert-Lewin. Noah Okafor stretches every sinew but can’t quite get a toe on the ball. It’s put out for a corner, from which nothing comes.

Leeds are in front! It’s been coming and it’s thoroughly deserved. James Justin connects with a Gudmondsson pull-back from the byline that Raya tried to intercept but missed. He sends the ball fizzing past a couple of defenders and into the back of the net from about 15 yards out.

53 min: James Justin sends a curled shot from distance whistling narrowly wide of the far post. Soon afterwards, David Raya is forced to tip an Ao Tanaka shot over the bar after a heavy touch from Declan Rice gifted a shooting opportunity to the Japan international. I don’t think it’s an exaggeration to say Arsenal are on the ropes here.

51 min: Everything good about Arsenal today is coming through Noni Madueke and on this occasion his pull-back from the left is met by Martin Odegaard. The Arsenal captain’s shot is weak and comfortably saved by by Trafford.

50 min: Quite apart from the chances they’ve created, Leeds deserve a lot of praise for their defensive fortitude and stoutness. They are incredibly well organised and disciplined out of possession and are smothering Arsenal any time they try to get forward.

48 min: Madueke overhits a cross from the left but Saka is able to backpedal and try to nod the ball across the face of goal. He’s leaning back and get much power on his header and Trafford allows it to drop wide of the near post.
47 min: Saka plays a weighted pass to the byline for Ben White to chase. It’s overhit and the ball runs ourt of play again.
46 min: Muharemovic shields the ball well under pressure from Saka. It runs safely out play for a Leeds goal-kick.
46 min: Play resumes with Arsenal on the ball and no changes in personnel on either side.

An email: “Re: Mark Kerry’s pre-match concerns about Arsenal’s lack of a natural goalscorer,” writes Justin Kavanagh. “Fear not, Mark, I’m sure there’ll be a big, prolific Viking available to sign in the next transfer window.”

It’s all square at the break and while Arsenal have dominated possession, Leeds have had by far the better chances. Noah Okafor went close from distance, before Jayden Bogle accidentally blocked an Anton Stach volley from close range.

Ethan Ampadu was next to try his luck with an opportunistic header from distance, only to be foiled by Raya, who also needed all his guile to keep out a Gudmundsson shot from a tight angle just before the break.
In stark contrast, decent Arsenal chances have been at a premium, the pick of them falling to Kai Havertz on the back of industrious work from Noni Madueke.
45+2 min: Arsenal have a loud penalty appeal turned down when a Saka run to try to press James Trafford is blocked by Muharemovic. It’s half-time.

44 min: A Leeds cross from the right evades the wrestling bout between Gabriel and Dominic Calvert-Lewin on the edge of the six-yard box and drops to Gudmondsson at the far post. He smashes the ball from a tight angle, forcing a superb save out of David Raya. Leeds are giving Arsenal plenty to think about in this first half. They’ve been outstanding.
43 min: Tanaka robs Rice as the Arsenal midfielder tried to rampage forward into Leeds territory.
42 min: Madueke cuts inside from the left again and gets the ball on to his right foot before pinging a little cross to Havertz. It’s a tall order and the German heads high over the bar.

40 min: Stach and Bogle get their wires crossed again, the latter pulling up and failing to make the run expected of him after playing a give-and-go with the former. Bogle gave but didn’t go, prompting Stach to throw his arms in the air in frustration.

38 min: Now Ethan Ampadu has his name taken for a foul on Ben White. Both Leeds central midfielders have been cautioned, as has their head coach, Daniel Farke. He didn’t foul anyone but I beleive he might have hurt the fourth official’s feelings.
37 min: Ao Tanaka is booked for a foul on Myles Lewis-Skelly.

34 min: Anton Stach takes a free-kick from deep, which Raya comes to punch clear. Ethan Ampadu sends a looping header goalwards and Raya has to be on his toes to get back to catch the ball before slamming on the brakes in order to avoid carrying it over his own line.
Disaster averted, Raya promptly pings a long diagonal to Madueke, who drills a low cross into the Leeds penalty area that Saka is unable to connect with under pressure from Stach.

32 min: Arsenal continue to dominate possessioon against a Leeds United side who have had the three best chances of the opening half-hour. Justin remains pitchside, waiting in frustration to be ushered back on after receiving treatment. He eventually gets the signal from referee Paul Tierney.
31 min: Justin has his nostrils plugged by the medics and play resumes.

items.titleZh: 阿森纳 2-1 利兹联：英超联赛实况
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳在主场一度落后的情况下顽强逆转，以 2-1 击败表现出色的利兹联，全取三分。
bodyZh: 阿森纳主教练在接受 TNT 体育采访时表示：“赛前我们讨论了两件事。第一：即将到来的挑战，因为利兹联在英超保持不败，比赛会非常艰难。第二：无论比赛背景如何，都要恢复我们的身份，重新做回自己。我们对对阵布莱顿的表现不满意，今天是纠正错误的机会。我们的确按预期做出了反应。”
谈到阿森纳改变比赛的扳平进球：“当你下午 12:30 在主场作战且 0-1 落后时，你必须恢复很多东西。能量就是其中之一。我们有了不可思议的回应。你能感受到看台上的气氛，能量瞬间改变了。替补球员上场后发挥了巨大作用，帮助我们赢得了比赛。”
阿森纳：枪手将于周二晚上在主场迎战法国球队里尔，随后将于下周日前往城市球场对阵诺丁汉森林。
利兹联：在遭遇本赛季英超首场失利后，丹尼尔·法尔克的球队有一周多的时间进行调整，然后将于下周日在埃兰路球场迎战曼联，这将是一场火药味十足的较量。
这位巴西球员在接受 TNT 体育采访时表示：“感觉太不可思议了。我觉得上一场对阵布莱顿的比赛我们不在状态。今天的精神面貌是反弹。这是我的第一场主场正式比赛。进球的感觉太不可思议了，这是一个重要的进球，拿到了三分。这是一次伟大的射门，我非常高兴。”
当被问及他是否觉得需要向阿尔特塔证明自己时，他说：“我想给他制造一点小麻烦，但在过去五年里我一直在英超证明自己。对我来说这是一个新挑战，上场比赛总是很重要的。对布鲁诺来说，最重要的是上场踢出最好的足球，我对此感到非常高兴。”
英超比赛报告：阿森纳对阵利兹联的表现不算太好，但展现了令人印象深刻的韧性，在落后一球的情况下逆转，击败了强劲的对手，并在漫长的国际比赛日后重置了状态。保罗·麦金尼斯在酋长球场为您报道……
周六赛事追踪：莎拉·兰德尔在这里为您带来今天下午三点开球的四场比赛中所有进球和主要话题的最新消息……
哔！哔！哔——！酋长球场的一场精彩比赛落下帷幕，阿森纳在落后的情况下付出巨大努力，击败了表现极为出色的利兹联队。
比赛进行到第 55 分钟时，詹姆斯·贾斯廷为客队首开纪录，他的射门十分利落。在上半场表现出色却未能破门之后，他们的领先优势完全实至名归。七分钟后，里卡多·卡拉菲奥里为阿森纳扳平比分，从那一刻起，比赛便呈一边倒之势。
阿森纳的制胜球是一个精彩的团队配合进球，布鲁诺·吉马良斯在其中扮演了主角，他策动了这次进攻，并以一记精彩的低射完成了终结。利兹联队昂首离开，他们让阿森纳为了这场胜利付出了极其艰辛的努力。
第 90+5 分钟：约克雷斯将球传给萨卡，后者直面利兹联防线，单刀面对特拉福德。利兹联门将封堵成功，迫使阿森纳边锋将球射偏。这是本场比赛的最后一脚射门，裁判吹响了全场比赛结束的哨音。
第 90+5 分钟：古德蒙德松从左路传中送入阿森纳禁区。加布里埃尔头球解围。
第 90+4 分钟：利兹联掷出界外球，伊桑·阿姆帕杜将球掷入阿森纳禁区。球被头球解围。
第 90+2 分钟：由于特拉福德在一次冲动后处于无人看管的尴尬境地，维克托·约克雷斯在试图从 30 码外把球带进球门时，竟然错失了至少一次面对空门得分的机会。你在干什么？！
第 90+1 分钟：比赛进入五分钟补时。利兹联能否在这场比赛中抢到他们几乎肯定配得上的积分？
第 90 分钟：阿森纳换人：米克尔·梅里诺换下厄德高，后者在帮助阿森纳扳平比分并打入制胜球的过程中发挥了关键作用。
第 89 分钟：多米尼克·卡尔沃特-勒温的传中球击中尤里安·廷贝尔后折射，但未能落到阿伦森脚下。
第 87 分钟：自从阿森纳扳平比分后，利兹联似乎已经耗尽了体能和想法。他们在前 65 分钟表现得极为出色，但阿森纳在面对极端逆境时展现了强大的实力。
第 85 分钟：利兹联连换两人：让·马特奥·巴霍亚和雅卡·比约尔换下博格尔和埃尔维迪。
第 82 分钟：尤里安·廷贝尔将球传到远门柱，德克兰·赖斯停下球，假动作晃过杰登·博格尔，随后将球抽入六码禁区。球被穆哈雷莫维奇封堵，但正好落到厄德高的胫骨上。不知何故，他竟然没能进球，特拉福德扑出了这脚他自己都有些懵的射门。在赖斯在狭小空间内完成精彩的小碎步舞步后，利兹联逃过一劫。谁能想到他还有这一手？
第 81 分钟：阿森纳换人：皮耶罗·欣卡皮耶换下里卡多·卡拉菲奥里。
第 80 分钟：利兹联换人：法尔克派上卢卡斯·恩梅查换下詹姆斯·贾斯廷，阵型从五后卫转换为 4-4-2。
第 78 分钟：德克兰·赖斯将一记任意球头球解围出阿森纳禁区，随后高高跃起将回传球顶出。阿森纳试图反击，但詹姆斯·贾斯廷战术犯规拉倒布鲁诺，吃到了黄牌。
第 76 分钟：利兹联几分钟前的两次换人：哈里·威尔逊和布伦登·阿伦森换下田中碧和奥卡福，两人此前表现都非常出色。
第 75 分钟：萨卡带球率领阿森纳众将潮水般前压。尽管有队友支援，他还是选择单干，结果将球射高出横梁。
第 72 分钟：布鲁诺主罚快发任意球并策动、终结了这次进攻。皮球被传向左路，经由萨卡传给内侧的厄德高，再到赖斯，赖斯用一脚大胆的脚后跟磕传将球送到了进球者的脚下。
阿森纳领先！这是一次精彩的团队配合，萨卡、厄德高和赖斯等球员参与了进球的构建，随后布鲁诺·吉马良斯在禁区边缘一脚低射将球轰入球门远角。
第 67 分钟：自扳平比分并进行人员调整后，阿森纳暂时掌控了比赛节奏。卡尔沃特-勒温封堵传中后，皮球落到禁区边缘的卡拉菲奥里脚下。这位意大利球员的射门十分离谱，远离了球门目标。
第 64 分钟：阿森纳连换三人：尤里安·廷贝尔、布鲁诺·吉马良斯和维克托·约克雷斯换下怀特、刘易斯-斯凯利和哈弗茨。
阿森纳扳平比分！马杜埃凯从左路传中到远门柱，本·怀特在底线附近将球顶回利兹联禁区。卡拉菲奥里在无人盯防的巨大空间里，像一个刚看到老鼠的维多利亚时代女佣一样高高跃起，打出一记精巧的凌空垫射，皮球飞越特拉福德。利兹联门将碰到了皮球，但没能阻止其入网。
第 61 分钟：利兹联从后场组织并通过阿森纳中路推进，马丁·厄德高像一个在交通高峰期的安非他命交警一样手舞足蹈，试图让阿森纳的队友们去紧逼对手。
第 59 分钟：阿森纳在极具威胁的位置赢得任意球，但马丁·厄德高的传球直接落入了詹姆斯·特拉福德的怀中。
第 58 分钟：在多米尼克·卡尔沃特-勒温精彩的做球之后，杰登·博格尔送出一记精彩的低平传中划过阿森纳禁区。诺亚·奥卡福拼尽全力也没能碰到皮球。皮球被解围出底线形成角球，但角球未能制造威胁。
利兹联领先！这个进球酝酿已久，且完全实至名归。雷亚试图拦截古德蒙德松自底线的倒三角回传但未能碰到，詹姆斯·贾斯廷抓住机会跟进，在距球门约 15 码处将球从数名防卫队员身侧呼啸着轰入球网。
第 53 分钟：詹姆斯·贾斯廷远射弧线球，皮球擦着远门柱呼啸而过。不久之后，由于德克兰·赖斯停球失误给这位日本国脚创造了射门机会，大卫·雷亚被迫将田中碧的射门托出横梁。毫不夸张地说，阿森纳现在正处于风雨飘摇之中。
第 51 分钟：阿森纳今天所有出彩的进攻都通过诺亚·马杜埃凯发起，这一次他从左路的倒三角回传找到了马丁·厄德高。阿森纳队长的射门绵软无力，被特拉福德轻松没收。
第 50 分钟：除了创造的进球机会外，利兹联的防守坚韧度也值得大加赞赏。他们在无球状态下的组织和纪律性极其出色，每当阿森纳试图向前推进时，他们都会进行窒息式防守。
第 48 分钟：马杜埃凯左路传中稍大，但萨卡后退调整并试图将球顶向球门方向。由于身体后倾，他的头球缺乏力量，特拉福德目送皮球从近门柱外侧滚出底线。
第 47 分钟：萨卡送出精准直塞，本·怀特高速前插追赶。传球力量稍大，皮球再次滚出底线。
第 46 分钟：在萨卡的逼抢下，穆哈雷莫维奇成功护球。皮球安全滚出底线，利兹联获得球门球。
第 46 分钟：比赛恢复，阿森纳控球，双方均未进行人员调整。
一封邮件：“关于马克·凯瑞赛前对阿森纳缺乏正印射手的担忧，”贾斯廷·卡瓦纳格写道，“别担心，马克，我确信在下一个转会窗会有一名身材高大、多产的维京人可供签约。”
半场结束时双方战平，虽然阿森纳占据了控球优势，但利兹联创造了迄今为止更好的得分机会。诺亚·奥卡福险些远射破门，随后杰登·博格尔在门前近距离无意中挡出了安东·斯塔赫的凌空抽射。
伊桑·阿姆帕杜随后尝试了一脚机会主义的远距离头球，但被雷亚化解。雷亚还在半场结束前凭借精湛的技巧扑出了古德蒙德松小角度的射门。
相比之下，阿森纳像样的机会寥寥无几，其中最好的机会落在了在马杜埃凯勤奋工作后获得良机的哈弗茨脚上。
第 45+2 分钟：萨卡前场逼抢詹姆斯·特拉福德时被穆哈雷莫维奇阻挡，阿森纳强烈抗议点球未被判罚。半场比赛结束。
第 44 分钟：利兹联右路传中越过了在六码禁区边缘缠斗的加布里埃尔和多米尼克·卡尔沃特-勒温，落到了远门柱的古德蒙德松脚下。他小角度怒射，逼出大卫·雷亚神级扑救。在上半场比赛中，利兹联给阿森纳制造了巨大的麻烦。他们的表现堪称卓越。
第 43 分钟：田中碧趁阿森纳中场带球狂奔推进到利兹联腹地时断下赖斯的脚下球。
第 42 分钟：马杜埃凯再次从左路内切，用右脚控球后将球吊入禁区传给哈弗茨。这球难度较大，德国人的头球高出横梁。
第 40 分钟：斯塔赫和博格尔再次出现默契失误，后者在与前者进行二过一配合后突然停下，没有完成预期的前插。博格尔送出传球却没跑位，气得斯塔赫沮丧地双手叉腰。
第 38 分钟：伊桑·阿姆帕杜因对本·怀特犯规吃到黄牌。利兹联的两名中前卫以及他们的主教练丹尼尔·法尔克都已染黄。他虽然没对任何人犯规，但我相信他可能伤害了第四官员的感情。
第 37 分钟：田中碧因对迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利犯规被黄牌警告。
第 34 分钟：安东·斯塔赫主罚大禁区外任意球，雷亚出击将球双拳击出。伊桑·阿姆帕杜顺势完成一记吊向球门的头球，雷亚反应神速回追将球抱住，随后紧急刹车避免将球带过自家门线。
灾难解除，雷亚迅速长传调度找到马杜埃凯，后者低平球抽入利兹联禁区，萨卡在斯塔赫的干扰下未能碰到皮球。
第 32 分钟：阿森纳继续主导对利兹联的控球，而利兹联在上半场前三十分钟内获得了三次绝佳机会。贾斯廷仍在场边接受治疗，焦急地等待被允许重新登场。他最终得到了主裁判保罗·蒂尔尼的信号。
第 31 分钟：医务人员塞住贾斯廷的鼻孔后，比赛恢复。

items.titleEn: Bruno Guimarães completes Arsenal comeback to end Leeds’ unbeaten run
items.summaryEn: Arsenal built the foundations of their new success on a desire for competition, an appetite for battle. But what happens when that spirit is insufficient, when your opponents play just as hard as you do? Well, then you bring on Bruno Guimarães and you play even harder.Arsenal had just snatched an equaliser against a dominant Leeds side when Mikel Arteta introduced his key summer signing. The former Newcastle captain has been having to bide his time but when he entered the field just after the hour, he turned the game on its head. Continue reading...
bodyEn: Arsenal built the foundations of their new success on a desire for competition, an appetite for battle. But what happens when that spirit is insufficient, when your opponents play just as hard as you do? Well, then you bring on Bruno Guimarães and you play even harder.

Arsenal had just snatched an equaliser against a dominant Leeds side when Mikel Arteta introduced his key summer signing. The former Newcastle captain has been having to bide his time but when he entered the field just after the hour, he turned the game on its head.

Arsenal had been ponderous until this point, even uncertain at times. The passing had been intricate, not incisive, and echoes of familiar weaknesses had put the crowd on edge. Guimarães put paid to all that. Not only snapping into tackles, not only moving the ball at pace, he was desperate for everything to go faster, more aggressively, with sharper intention. Nine minutes after coming on, he scored the winner.

It was a goal that deserved to decide the contest and reflected the best of what the home side had been trying to achieve. Play developed down the left where Noni Madueke had shone, but here it was Bukayo Saka playing a one-two with Martin Ødegaard. The captain then poked a short pass to Declan Rice who – with Guimarães now covering him – had burst into the opposition area. Rice back-heeled the ball to the edge of the area and there was the Brazilian waiting, poised, to steer the ball unerringly into the corner of James Trafford’s goal.

In the time between Leeds’ opener and the winner, Arsenal had five efforts on goal, the same as in the preceding 55 minutes. Once the lead was established, they should have had at least two more goals, with Ødegaard somehow missing from two yards out and Trafford denying Saka in a one-on-one in the final move of the match. Leeds did not feature as an attacking threat in the final half hour, so decisive was the switch in momentum.
Arteta said his team had to “pinch our desire to win” to overcome a visiting side who appear no longer to be punching above their weight, but rather have moved up a class.

“We had to face the challenge because [Leeds] are a team that hadn’t lost in the Premier League,” he said. “They’re in a great position because they fully deserve it. They are incredibly dangerous and we got into a situation, [a goal down] after that defeat against Brighton, 12:30 kick-off.
“It is a bad mixture and we got out of it through … pinching our desire to win, by showing the personality and courage that we have in this team.”

Arteta will be able to take satisfaction from the way his team managed the result, the effectiveness of his substitutes and other smaller details such as the continuing creative contributions of Rice – now with three assists to his name – and a second goal for Riccardo Calafiori, whose buccaneering inside runs have been a feature of the season.

On the other hand, his midfield was outmuscled and outplayed in the first hour, with the opening 10 minutes of the second half a period of dominance for the visitors that deservedly delivered a goal when James Justin finished Gabriel Gudmundsson’s cross after the Swede had run off the back of Ben White.

Arsenal’s centre-halves, are looking like less of the sum of their parts, with Ezri Konsa and Gabriel uncertain when faced with the accuracy and variation of Leeds’ deliveries.

“It’s a credit to the mentality that Mikel Arteta has created, that even on a tough day they found a way to win”, said Daniel Farke. The German bemoaned the Arsenal equaliser, bundled home by Calafiori after White had knocked down a Madueke cross, believing that if Trafford had got a hand to it, “we would have gone on to take three points.”

With the proviso that there can be no back-slapping in defeat, however, Farke said the match showed his team’s improvement since returning to the Premier League. “We have developed in all aspects,” he said. “You can speak about game management, you can speak about pressing, about compactness against the ball, or quality in possession, or in counterattacks. We were able to compete much better with set pieces.
“Today we came very close to winning an away game against one of the best sides in the world and we played exactly on their level, more or less.”

items.titleZh: 布鲁诺·吉马良斯完成逆转，阿森纳终结利兹联不败纪录
items.summaryZh: 替补上阵的吉马良斯制胜，阿森纳逆转利兹联。
bodyZh: 阿森纳新成功的基础是对竞争的渴望和对战斗的胃口。但当这种精神不够用，当对手的拼抢与你一样凶狠时，会发生什么呢？很简单，这时候你就要换上布鲁诺·吉马良斯，然后踢得更加凶狠。
就在米克尔·阿尔特塔派上这位今夏关键引援前不久，阿森纳刚刚在面对占据优势的利兹联时扳平了比分。这位前纽卡斯尔队长一直在耐心地等待机会，但当他在比赛过了一小时后替补登场时，他彻底扭转了局势。
在此之前，阿森纳的进攻显得有些沉闷，甚至有时底气不足。传球虽然繁复但不够犀利，人们熟悉的老毛病让场边球迷捏了一把汗。吉马良斯一上来就改变了这一切。他不仅抢断凶狠、传球节奏明快，而且极其渴望让比赛提速、更具侵略性、更有威胁。登场九分钟后，他打入了制胜球。
这是一个配得上决定比赛胜局的进球，也体现了主队一直以来试图达到的最佳水准。进攻从马杜埃凯发挥出色的左路发起，随后布卡约·萨卡与马丁·厄德高进行了撞墙配合。队长厄德高随后将球短传给插禁区协助的德克兰·赖斯（此时吉马良斯正在保护他）。赖斯脚后跟磕球到禁区边缘，而巴西人早已等候在那里，从容不迫地将球准确送入詹姆斯·特拉福德把守球门死角。
在利兹联首开纪录到阿森纳制胜球之间，阿森纳完成了五次射门，这与此前55分钟的总射门次数持平。一旦取得领先，他们本该再进至少两球——厄德高在两码处不可思议地错失良机，而特拉福德在比赛最后一刻的单刀中封堵了萨卡的射门。由于局势发生决定性转变，利兹联在最后半小时里再也无法构成进攻威胁。
阿尔特塔表示，球队必须“激发获胜的渴望”，才能击败这支不再是超水平发挥、而是已经提升了一个档次的客队。
他说：“我们必须迎接挑战，因为（利兹联）是一支在英超中保持不败的球队。他们处在极佳的位置上，因为这是他们应得的。他们极其危险，我们在对阵布莱顿失利后、于12点半开球的比赛中陷入了落后的境地。”
“这是一个糟糕的组合，而我们通过……激发获胜的渴望，通过展现这支球队所拥有的个性和勇气，最终摆脱了困境。”
阿尔特塔对球队掌控比赛结果的方式、替补球员的效率以及其他一些细节感到满意，比如赖斯持续贡献的创造力（目前他已有三次助攻），以及里卡尔多·卡拉菲奥里的第二粒进球，这位后卫本赛季内切突破表现抢眼。
另一方面，他的中场在头一个小时里在对抗和场面上处于下风，下半场前10分钟更是客队的天下，随着瑞典人加布里埃尔·古德蒙德松摆脱本·怀特传中，詹姆斯·贾斯廷破门，客队的进球实至名归。

通讯推广后
阿森纳的中卫组合看起来状态一般，面对利兹联精准多变的传中时，埃兹里·孔萨和加布里埃尔显得信心不足。
丹尼尔·法尔克说：“这要归功于米克尔·阿尔特塔打造的心态，即使在艰难的一天里他们也找到了取胜的方法。”这位德国教练对阿森纳的扳平球感到遗憾，当时怀特将马杜埃凯的传中顶回，卡拉菲奥里混战破门。他认为如果特拉福德能扑到球，“我们就能带走三分了。”
不过法尔克也强调，虽然失利不值得自我吹捧，但这场比赛表明了球队自重返英超以来取得的进步。“我们在各个方面都有所提升，”他说。“你可以谈论比赛管理、高位压迫、防守紧凑性、控球质量或反击质量。我们在定位球争夺上也踢得好得多。”
“今天我们在客场对阵世界上最好的球队之一时非常接近胜利，而且我们在很大程度上和他们踢得不相上下。”

items.titleEn: Managers react to Manchester City’s guilty verdict: ‘Uncertainty is not good for anyone’
items.summaryEn: United manager Carrick rues missing out on ‘emotion in the moment’ while Iraola says he understands why Liverpool fans are angry Continue reading...
bodyEn: Michael Carrick has said retrospectively receiving a winner’s medal would not make up for being robbed of emotional moments of glory by Manchester City’s breaches of the Premier League’s financial rules.

Manchester United’s manager was part of the squad that lost out on the Premier League title to City on the final day of the 2011-12 season when Sergio Agüero scored a last-minute winner to secure top spot on goal difference. Carrick and his United teammates were left solemn on the touchline at Sunderland while City, who have been found guilty of breaking financial rules during a nine-year-period between 2009 and 2018, celebrated.

“The emotion, the feeling about winning, a lot of it is in the moment,” Carrick said. “Whether you’re successful, whether you lose, whether it goes against you, that initial [feeling], the beauty of sport and the beauty of football and the beauty of trying to win trophies here, is a little bit on the journey towards it and then the finale, and does it go for you, does it go against you.

“Once that’s done, there’s no getting that back in any direction. The feeling we all crave is coming out on top – that kind of sums it up. Whatever’s done in the past tense is in the past, but in that moment is how you feel in that moment. Certainly as a participant, as a performer, and I’m sure the supporters feel the same, that’s why we love it so much because of the emotion in the moment.”

Carrick was also part of United’s staff under Ole Gunnar Solskjær when they finished second, 22 points behind City, in 2021. City continue to plead their innocence and have appealed against the verdict. If they fail to overturn the independent commission’s ruling, they will probably face a serious punishment.

“It’s affected me personally in different ways,” Carrick said. “But as the case is ongoing now I don’t know where that stands and how it’s going to end up, so we’ll just have to wait and see. What I will say, the sooner it gets sorted I think for everyone’s benefit is essential.” Will Unwin

Andoni Iraola understands the anger among Liverpool supporters towards Manchester City and believes the Premier League needs a resolution to the scandal engulfing English football as swiftly as possible.

Iraola avoided condemning City during his first press conference since the club were found guilty of breaching Premier League financial rules on an industrial scale over nine years. City have lodged an appeal against the findings and Liverpool’s head coach admitted a final, definitive verdict is essential for the good of the game. “I think it should be [concluded quickly],” he said. “There should be a moment when something comes from this, but now is not that moment. Nobody knows what is going to happen and I think this uncertainty is no good for anyone.”

While refusing to be drawn on the controversy while the legal process is ongoing, Iraola acknowledged the strength of feeling that will be directed at City by Liverpool fans at Anfield on Sunday. City pipped Liverpool to the Premier League title in 2013-14, 2018-19 and 2021-22, the latter two during the fierce rivalry that developed between Jürgen Klopp’s and Pep Guardiola’s teams. Sunday’s reception for the current league leaders promises to be brutal.

“We understand and I understand everything that goes above football,” said Iraola. “Every fan will have their own opinion and attitude towards that but it’s not something that I can control. I need to do my job, to give the best game we can give on the sporting side, so everyone of our supporters is happy on Sunday. I think the challenge of the game for us is big.”

Liverpool’s task on Sunday, as Iraola referenced, will be complicated by the absence of leading goalscorer Alexander Isak and the in-form Cody Gakpo due to injuries sustained on international duty. The two are not long-term absentees but, with Liverpool facing four games in 10 days, they could miss several matches. He admitted: “It’s a bad thing for us, definitely, because both of them have been prolific at the start of the season but the good thing when you coach Liverpool is you still have very good players available. I trust the players we have ready to go. It’s also a good moment for those players to step up, to add good numbers and good performances while we recover Cody and Alex.” Andy Hunter

Vincent Kompany, the former Manchester City captain, insists he is still “really proud” of his success with the club after it was found guilty of breaching Premier League financial rules. The Bayern Munich manager won four Premier League titles and multiple domestic cups during his spell at City from 2008 to 2019.
The former Belgium international was a key figure in City’s dominant era under their Abu Dhabi-based owners and is honoured with a statue outside the Etihad Stadium.
“I played 11 years for the club. I’ve loved all of the years I played for the club and everything we achieved and [did] on the pitch – that’s something I’m really proud of,” Kompany said.

Kompany signed for City from Hamburg just weeks before Sheikh Mansour completed a takeover that turned the club from also-rans to serial winners. Asked about the off-pitch issues at his former club, he said: “Everything else, as a player you’re not a part of that and right now as a coach of Bayern Munich I’m not too much occupied with that topic. I’m preparing the game next week and preparing the game we have tomorrow and everything I have as a coach.” Agence France-Presse

Mikel Arteta has insisted his conscience is clear about his time as Manchester City’s assistant manager and promised to “talk with clarity” about his former club when their appeal against a guilty verdict on more than 100 Premier League’s charges has been decided.

Arteta spent more than three years as Pep Guardiola’s assistant at City before moving to Arsenal in December 2019. The Spaniard, who signed a lucrative new four-year contract this week, moved to the Etihad in July 2016 and was part of Guardiola’s backroom staff as they won titles in 2018 and 2019.

The first came during the period in which City breached financial regulations, according to an independent commission. Arteta was reluctant to discuss any potential punishment City could face but was asked whether his conscience was clear from his spell at City and responded: “Yes.”

That was as far as he was prepared to venture after being bombarded with questions about City before Arsenal’s game against Leeds on Saturday. Arteta had been due to deliver a statement at the start of his press conference but the plan changed at the last minute. He refused to be drawn on how he felt when he heard the verdict or whether the uncertainty it had created would have a long-term impact on the Premier League’s brand.

“I want to think that it doesn’t, but I don’t know,” he said. “Uncertainty is not in our control and our control is to bring everything that we can individually through the club to maintain the position that we have to be the best league in the world.”

Arteta added: “The thing is that this has been going for various years. That process is still not finished. So it is very difficult to express how I feel, because it is not resolved. When it is resolved I can talk with clarity and tell you exactly how I feel.”

It is understood Arsenal and other Premier League clubs are keen for the situation to be resolved as quickly as possible, although City’s appeal means it could drag on until at least the new year. Arteta also dismissed suggestions Arsenal could be the main beneficiaries should City find themselves relegated, having finished as runners up to them three years in a row before becoming champions last season.
“I think we control our accelerator, and believe me, for seven years it’s been full gas in everything that we can do and take in every corner at maximum speed,” he said. Ed Aarons

Roberto De Zerbi insists he has no time to dwell on Manchester City’s guilty verdict with Tottenham bottom of the table. De Zerbi was a Napoli player when they faced Juventus in the 2006-07 season after Juve were found guilty of match-fixing and relegated to Serie B.

Juventus had an initial 30-point deduction reduced to nine and still won promotion straight back to Serie A. Asked what the experience was like, De Zerbi replied: “I was crazy as a player, I don’t remember my thoughts, just think on the ball, just think on our job.

“When you are a player, you don’t think too much. When you are a coach, the same because the focus is on your players, especially now because we are on the bottom of the table. I have no time to think of the other problems than my team, my club.”

The Spurs manager said the scandal did not change Italian football, and added: “There are the people who have to decide to take the decision, with responsibility, with courage, and honesty, always. It’s not my job. My job is to be a coach. But I love respecting the rules, like all people in our club.”

Dejan Kulusevski is on the verge of returning after more than 500 days out with a complex knee injury. The forward will travel to Manchester for Sunday’s crunch match against United to support the team as he closes in on a comeback.
De Zerbi told his squad in a meeting that Kulusevski had set an example to them. “He’s an inspiration,” he said. “He reacted very well, with character, with courage, with passion.”
De Zerbi said the first week of the three-week international break had been particularly “tough” and that he suffered “a lot”. The 47-year-old took a short holiday but was unable to switch off.
“If you work with passion and work like me, you can’t go home and forget your work, especially in this type of moment – it’s inside you,” he said.
He believes Spurs can replicate Aston Villa, who failed to win any of their first five Premier League games last season before winning 12 of their next 13 and qualifying for the Champions League.
“It’s possible. Why not? But to do what Villa did, we have to click. But I think the first win is not a gift from God. You have to deserve to win. And we didn’t deserve to win so far.” Sam Cunningham

items.titleZh: 各队主帅谈曼城被判违规：不确定性对任何人都没有好处
items.summaryZh: 多位英超主帅谈曼城被判违规，阿尔特塔表示问心无愧，并将等案件彻底结束后再做清晰表达。
bodyZh: 迈克尔·卡里克表示，由于曼城违反了英超财务规则，他错失了当时的情感荣耀时刻，而事后获得冠军奖牌也无法弥补这一点。
这位曼联主帅是2011-12赛季最后一天在积分榜上因净胜球劣势输给曼城的那支球队的成员，当时塞尔吉奥·阿圭罗打入了压哨绝杀。卡里克和他的曼联队友在桑德兰的场边显得十分落寞，而曼城则在庆祝他们被指控在2009年至2018年期间违反财务规则的这九年里所取得的成果。
卡里克说：“那种情感，关于获胜的感觉，很大程度上在于当下。无论你是成功了，还是失败了，或者结果对你不利，最初的感受、体育的美妙、足球的美妙以及在这里努力赢得奖杯的美妙，都在于通往目标的旅程以及最后的结局，看结果是偏向你还是背离你。”
“一旦这一切结束了，就再也无法以任何方式找回那种感觉了。我们所有人渴望的感觉都是登顶——这大致就是全部。过去发生的事情已经成为过去，但在那一刻，你的感觉就是那一刻的感受。当然，作为一名参与者、作为一名表演者，我相信球迷们也有同感，这就是为什么我们如此热爱它，因为它包含了当下的情感。”
在2021年曼联落后曼城22分获得亚军时，卡里克也曾在索尔斯克亚手下的曼联教练组任职。曼城继续坚称自己无辜，并已对裁决提出上诉。如果他们未能推翻独立委员会的裁决，他们可能会面临严重的惩罚。
卡里克说：“这在不同的方面对我的个人产生了影响。但由于案件目前仍在进行中，我不知道它目前的状况如何，最终会如何结束，所以我们只能拭目以待。我要说的是，越早解决这件事对所有人的利益来说都是必不可少的。”
安东尼·伊劳拉理解利物浦球迷对曼城愤怒的心情，并认为英超联赛需要尽快对这桩笼罩着英格兰足球的丑闻做出最终裁决。
在曼城被判定大规模违反英超财务规则后的首场新闻发布会上，伊劳拉避免对曼城进行谴责。曼城已对裁决结果提出上诉，而利物浦主帅承认，一个最终的、决定性的裁决对足球运动的发展至关重要。他说：“我认为应该迅速结案。应该有一个事情尘埃落定的时候，但现在还不是那个时刻。没有人知道会发生什么，我认为这种不确定性对任何人都没有好处。”
虽然在法律程序进行期间拒绝卷入这一争议，但伊劳拉承认，周日利物浦球迷在安菲尔德对曼城时将会流露出强烈的情绪。曼城在2013-14赛季、2018-19赛季和2021-22赛季都曾力压利物浦夺得英超冠军，后两次发生在于克洛普和佩普·瓜迪奥拉的球队之间激烈的竞争时期。周日对现任联赛领头羊的迎接注定将是残酷的。
伊劳拉说：“我们理解，我也理解所有超越足球的事情。每个球迷都会对此有自己的观点和态度，但这并不是我所能控制的。我需要做好我的工作，在竞技层面奉献出我们能给出的最好比赛，这样我们的每一位球迷在周日都会感到高兴。我认为这场比赛对我们来说是一个巨大的挑战。”

正如伊劳拉所提及的，利物浦在周日的任务将因首席射手亚历山大·伊萨克和状态正佳的科迪·加克波因在国际比赛日受伤而缺阵而变得复杂。这两个人并非长期缺阵，但在利物浦10天内要踢4场比赛的情况下，他们可能会错过多场比赛。他承认：“这绝对是一件坏事，因为他们在赛季初都有很高的进球效率，但当你执教利物浦时，好的一面是你仍然有非常优秀的可用球员。我相信我们准备好的球员。在我们恢复科迪和亚历克斯的同时，这也是那些球员挺身而出、贡献出色数据和表现的好时机。”
前曼城队长文森特·孔帕尼坚称，在俱乐部被判定违反英超财务规则后，他依然对自己在俱乐部的成功感到“非常自豪”。这位拜仁慕尼黑主帅在2008年至2019年效力曼城期间赢得了四座英超冠军奖杯以及多项国内杯赛冠军。
这位前比利时国脚是曼城在阿布扎比老板统治下的统治时期的关键人物，并在阿提哈德球场外拥有一座雕像以表彰他的贡献。
孔帕尼说：“我在俱乐部效力了11年。我热爱我在俱乐部效力的所有岁月，以及我们在球场上取得和做到的一切——这是我真正感到自豪的事情。”
在谢赫·曼苏尔完成收购、将曼城从一支碌碌无为的球队转变为常胜将军的几周前，孔帕尼从汉堡转会加盟曼城。当被问及他前俱乐部场外的问题时，他说：“其他所有事情，作为一名球员，你并不是其中的一部分，而现在作为拜仁慕尼黑的主教练，我并没有过多地被这个话题所占据。我正在备战下周的比赛，备战我们明天的比赛，以及作为一名教练我所拥有的一切。”
米克尔·阿尔特塔坚称，对于自己在担任曼城助理教练期间的经历，他问心无愧，并承诺在针对曼城涉及100多项英超指控的有罪裁决的上诉有了结果后，将“清晰地谈论”他的前俱乐部。
在2019年12月转投阿森纳之前，阿尔特塔在瓜迪奥拉手下担任了三年多的曼城助教。这位本周刚签下一份丰厚四年新合同的西班牙人于2016年7月加盟阿提哈德球场，并作为瓜迪奥拉教练组的一员赢得了2018年和2019年的联赛冠军。
根据独立委员会的裁决，第一个冠军正是在曼城违反财务条例的时期获得的。阿尔特塔不愿讨论曼城可能面临的任何潜在惩罚，但当被问及他在曼城期间是否问心无愧时，他回答道：“是的。”
在阿森纳周六对阵利兹联的比赛前，他被关于曼城的各种问题狂轰滥炸，而这也是他愿意表达的极限。阿尔特塔原本计划在新闻发布会开始时发表一份声明，但该计划在最后一刻发生了变化。当被问及听到这一裁决时的感受，或者由此产生的不确定性是否会对英超联赛的品牌产生长期影响时，他拒绝过多发表意见。
他说：“我想认为不会，但我不知道。不确定性不在我们的控制范围内，而我们的控制范围是通过俱乐部个人的全部努力，来保持我们作为世界上最好联赛的地位。”
阿尔特塔补充道：“问题在于这件事已经持续了好几年。这个过程仍未结束。因此，很难表达我的感受，因为它尚未解决。当它解决时，我可以清晰地谈论并确切地告诉你我的感受。”
据了解，阿森纳和其他英超联赛俱乐部都希望这一局面能够尽快得到解决，尽管曼城的上诉意味着这可能会拖延到至少新年。阿尔特塔还驳斥了关于如果曼城遭到降级、阿森纳将成为主要受益者的说法，此前阿森纳连续三个赛季屈居亚军，并在上赛季夺得冠军。
他说：“我认为我们控制着自己的油门，相信我，七年来我们在所有能够做到和抓住的方面都以最大速度全速前进。”
罗伯托·德泽尔比坚称，由于热刺目前处于积分榜垫底，他没有时间去纠结曼城的有罪裁决。在2006-07赛季尤文图斯因假球案被判有罪并降入意乙时，德泽尔比曾效力于那不勒斯并与尤文交手。
尤文图斯最初被扣除30分后减至9分，但仍然直接升回意甲。当被问及那段经历是怎样的时，德泽尔比回答：“我当球员时很疯狂，我不记得我的想法了，只想着足球，只想着我们的工作。”
“当你是一名球员时，你不会想太多。当你是一名教练时也是如此，因为焦点都在你的球员身上，尤其是现在因为我们排在积分榜垫底。除了我的球队、我的俱乐部，我没有时间去思考其他问题。”
热刺主帅表示，这起丑闻并没有改变意大利足球，并补充道：“总有人必须做出决定，带着责任感、勇气和诚实，永远如此。这不是我的工作。我的工作是做一名教练。但我热爱遵守规则，就像我们俱乐部所有人一样。”
德扬·库卢塞夫斯基在因膝伤缺阵500多天后即将复出。这位前锋将前往曼彻斯特观看周日对阵曼联的焦点战，以在即将复出之际支持球队。
德泽尔比在一次会议上告诉他的全队，库卢塞夫斯基为他们树立了榜样。他说：“他是一个激励。他反应得很好，充满个性、勇气和激情。”
德泽尔比表示，为期三周的国际比赛日的第一周格外“艰难”，他“承受了很大痛苦”。这位47岁的主帅进行了短暂的度假，但无法让自己彻底放松。
他说：“如果你带着激情工作，像我一样工作，你回家后就无法忘记工作，特别是在这种类型的时刻——它已经融入了你的内心。”
他相信热刺可以复制阿斯顿维拉的轨迹，维拉在上赛季前五场英超联赛一场未胜的情况下，随后的13场比赛赢下了12场并获得了欧冠资格。
“这是可能的。为什么不呢？但要做到维拉所做的事情，我们必须产生化学反应。但我认为第一场胜利不是上帝的恩赐。你必须配得上胜利。而到目前为止，我们还配不上胜利。”

bodyEn: Declan Rice’s future role in England’s midfield was questioned by Gary Lineker after Alex Scott’s impressive first senior international start in the 7-0 thrashing of Croatia. But the decision to withdraw from Thomas Tuchel’s squad in an attempt to manage his workload made sense after Rice had only three weeks off post-World Cup before returning to pre-season training. The 27-year-old has struggled with persistent back problems after suffering a hamstring injury last December and Mikel Arteta will hope that the rest has done Rice – who is thought to be close to agreeing a lucrative new contract at the Emirates – the world of good as they prepare to resume the defence of their Premier League title against Leeds on Saturday. Ed Aarons
Arsenal v Leeds, Saturday 12.30pm (all times BST)

Several Aston Villa players shone for their countries during the international window but one of those who stayed with the club may have made the biggest impression on Unai Emery. Villa’s remaining squad went to Spain for a mid-season training camp, including Alejandro Garnacho, whose last cap for Argentina was almost two years ago. Garnacho has been lesser-spotted in a Villa shirt, playing just 31 minutes as a substitute, but scored in both of Villa’s friendlies during the break, against Southampton and Sevilla. The 22-year-old, who joined Villa on loan from Chelsea in the summer with a conditional obligation, was an unused substitute for their past four matches but is he now primed to affect games? Villa are hopeful Emery has unlocked Garnacho, who has struggled for form since leaving Manchester United. “Ready now!” Garnacho posted on social media last weekend and Villa will hope that is the case. Ben Fisher
Aston Villa v Brentford, Saturday 3pm

With Eli Junior Kroupi, Amine Adli, Veljko Milosavljevic and Julián Araujo yet to feature this season due to injury, Marco Rose must have been tearing his remaining hair out upon learning Alex Scott got hurt on England duty and will be out of action for two months. Sitting 17th and still searching for their first league win, the German’s side squandered nine points from winning positions in four of their first five games – and it was the 23-year-old who was central in ensuring Bournemouth had those leads in the first place. With just 55 minutes of football behind him this season, it seems unlikely Alex Toth will get the nod to replace Scott when Bournemouth travel to Chelsea with the older, more experienced Ryan Christie available and in good form. But having forced his way into the Hungary starting lineup during the international break it would be no surprise to see the 20-year-old get more minutes with a view to being used far more often given his side’s gruelling schedule of nine matches in the next month. Barry Glendenning
Chelsea v Bournemouth, Saturday 3pm

Ipswich’s place in mid-table, their total of six points, came via victories over Sunderland and Crystal Palace. Gary O’Neil’s team were presented with a tough opening schedule, and while defeated by Manchester United, Liverpool and Arsenal, their manager has not allowed those reverses to dilute team spirit. Speaking to the media following the home defeat by Liverpool, O’Neil painted an ultra-positive picture that defied most observers’ view of a game beyond his team’s reach from the early stages. Thus far, a successful strategy, certainly by comparison to early season at winless Fulham. Like O’Neil, Álvaro Arbeloa is new to his job. An improved performance in the draw against United did not result in a victory Fulham deserved, though there were signs of the progressive, attacking football the arrival of the former Real Madrid interim promised. Much of the burden has fallen on Josh King, the teenager building on last year’s breakthrough season. John Brewin
Ipswich v Fulham, Saturday 3pm

Still in the Carabao Cup, with a Europa League campaign to negotiate and just four points acquired from their opening five Premier League excursions, the games are about to start coming thick and fast for a Sunderland side whose ability to cope with such a hectic schedule remains to be seen. Having lost Dan Ballard and Brian Brobbey to hamstring injuries during the international break, Régis Le Bris will have to reshuffle his pack against a free-scoring Brighton side who make the 700-mile round trip to Wearside for their first game since embarrassing Arsenal three weeks ago. While Wilson Isidor will almost certainly deputise for Brobbey, Ballard’s centre-back berth will be filled by either Omar Alderete or Nordi Mukiele. Having shipped five last time out against Manchester City, a Sunderland defence that had looked conspicuously porous in the early stages of this season will need all their focus if they are to stop the gallop of a team that have already scored 16 goals. BG.
Sunderland v Brighton, Saturday 3pm

If “Dr Tottenham” is a thing, Manchester United possess their own healing powers for opponents. Self-harm is a factor too. They rolled out the welcome mat to Premier League newcomers Hull on opening day and Brighton were ushered back into a Carabao Cup tie. In United’s final game before the international break flagging Fulham were able to restore some faith, their goal via slapstick defending from Lisandro Martínez and Senne Lammens. Can Old Trafford, where fans will have regulatory matters at City to celebrate, lift the gloom for Tottenham? This season, like last season and the one before that, Spurs have assumed the mantle of crisis club, a status Michael Carrick’s January arrival temporarily removed from United. Lose to Tottenham, and the crisis prefix is likely to be reattached. Tottenham have done damage before. In September 2024, a 3-0 Spurs win at Old Trafford began Erik ten Hag’s hurtle towards the exit. Losing the Europa League final started Ruben Amorim’s downward spiral. Carrick beware? JB
Manchester United v Tottenham, Saturday 5.30pm

All eyes will be on Oliver Glasner as he returns to Selhurst Park with Nottingham Forest on an afternoon that will be emotionally charged for both sets of supporters and in the boardroom. The Crystal Palace chair, Steve Parish, sought to defuse tensions last week when he urged fans to “buck the trend” by welcoming the manager who led the south London club to the first three major trophies in their history in the space of 12 months. “I would be mortified if he gets anything other than the roof blown off,” said Parish. But given the strength of feeling towards Forest and their owner, Evangelos Marinakis – who is still blamed by some for Palace’s demotion to the Conference League at the expense of Forest last season – many have still not forgiven Glasner for joining their rivals and could still make their feelings known when the Austrian takes his seat in the dugout before kick-off. EA
Crystal Palace v Nottingham Forest, Sunday 2pm

In Sergej Jakirovic and David Moyes, Hull City and Everton boast two of the more “pragmatic” managers in the Premier League. Renowned for their safety-first defensive styles, both teams are happy to surrender possession, rank among the top flight’s lowest sides in pass completion rates, and rely on rapid transitions and set pieces for a major share of their total expected goals. A game featuring two defences that pride themselves on their obduracy may well be settled by a well-delivered dead ball into a packed penalty area. While it may not be aesthetically pleasing, expect to see the massed ranks of defenders on both sides spending much of Sunday afternoon bracing themselves for rearguard action while peering towards the sky. The last time these sides met in the Premier League, Everton ran out easy 4-0 winners. A decade on, the aerial traffic is unlikely to be quite so one-way. BG
Hull City v Everton, Sunday 2pm

Manchester City resume playing under the darkest of clouds, with a visit to their greatest rivals of a golden period now shrouded by a guilty verdict. Five Premier League wins from five under Enzo Maresca had offered hopes of success in a post-Pep Guardiola era. The dial has since moved on what constitutes success for a club where minds are consumed by legal issues but the band must play on. Can Maresca summon a siege mentality? City lifted a treble, including the Champions League, when the 100-plus charges first came to public light in 2023. The Anfield crowd will readily remind City of the infamy their club faces down. That Guardiola’s now-disputed dominance came at the cost of Jürgen Klopp’s great team will add to the ire, and very probably the pyro greeting to Anfield. Cool heads may be required in the policing and on the field, to which a return to focusing on football may offer welcome relief. JB
Liverpool v Manchester City, Sunday 4.30pm

International football’s incursions have curbed the adrenaline rush of Coventry’s win at Nottingham Forest and Jay Dasilva’s brilliant goal, his club’s first in the top division since 2001. That gave Frank Lampard foundations to build on, a blueprint, where Forest were allowed to blow themselves out before Dasilva’s strike came on the counter. It was Stephen Mfuni, 18, on loan from Manchester City, who starred in that rearguard effort on his Premier League debut. Coventry now seek a first Premier League goal at a stadium opened in 2005, after the club’s long decline had set in. Newcastle this week passed five years of the ownership of a consortium led by Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund. There have been two seasons of Champions League football, a trophy lifted and yet a sense of unfulfilled promise. Matthias Jaissle is leading the second phase of a jagged development process, this season’s positive signs tempered by reverses such as the 4-1 defeat by Leeds, shows how far Coventry must travel. JB
Coventry v Newcastle, Monday 8pm

items.titleZh: 英超周末前瞻：各项焦点赛事看点
items.summaryZh: 英超联赛重燃战火，阿森纳即将迎战利兹联。
bodyZh: 在克罗地亚队7-0大胜的比赛中，亚历克斯·斯科特（Alex Scott）迎来了成年国家队首秀且表现惊艳，这之后加里·莱因克尔（Gary Lineker）对德克兰·赖斯（Declan Rice）在英格兰队中场未来的角色提出了质疑。但赖斯在世界杯后仅休息三周便返回季前训练，为了管理他的体能负荷，选择退出托马斯·图赫尔（Thomas Tuchel）的阵容是合乎情理的。这位27岁的球员在去年12月遭遇腿筋受伤后，一直受到持续的背部问题困扰。阿森纳主帅米克尔·阿尔特塔（Mikel Arteta）希望这段休息时间对赖斯大有裨益——据信赖斯即将在酋长球场续签一份丰厚的新合同——因为他们正准备在周六对阵利兹联的比赛中恢复对英超冠军的卫冕。埃德·阿隆斯（Ed Aarons）
阿森纳对阵利兹联，周六下午12:30（所有时间均为英国夏令时）

几名阿斯顿维拉球员在国际比赛窗口期间为国争光，但在俱乐部留守的球员中，有一位可能给乌奈·埃梅里（Unai Emery）留下了最深刻的印象。维拉剩余的阵容前往西班牙进行赛季中期训练营，其中包括亚历杭德罗·加纳乔（Alejandro Garnacho），他上一次代表阿根廷国家队出场还是近两年前。加纳乔在维拉球衣下亮相较少，作为替补仅出场31分钟，但在维拉国际比赛日期间对阵南安普顿和塞维利亚的两场友谊赛中均有进球。这位22岁的球员在夏天以附带强制买断条款的租借形式从切尔西加盟维拉，过去四场比赛他都未能出场，但他现在准备好在比赛中发挥影响力了吗？维拉希望埃梅里能够彻底激活加纳乔，自从离开曼联后，加纳乔的状态一直挣扎。“现在准备好了！”加纳乔上周末在社交媒体上发文，维拉希望事实的确如此。本·费舍尔（Ben Fisher）
阿斯顿维拉对阵布伦特福德，周六下午3点

由于埃利·儒尼奥尔·克鲁皮（Eli Junior Kroupi）、阿明·阿德利（Amine Adli）、韦尔科·米洛萨维耶维奇（Veljko Milosavljevic）和朱利安·阿劳霍（Julián Araujo）本赛季因伤尚未出场，当马尔科·罗泽（Marco Rose）得知亚历克斯·斯科特在英格兰队效力时受伤将缺阵两个月时，他一定气得揪头发。目前排名第17位且仍在寻找联赛首胜，这位德国教练的球队在前五场比赛中有四场在领先的情况下丢掉了9分，而正是这位23岁的球员在伯恩茅斯取得领先的过程中起到了核心作用。由于本赛季只有55分钟的出场时间，当伯恩茅斯客场挑战切尔西时，亚历克斯·托特（Alex Toth）似乎不太可能得到首发机会来替代斯科特，因为经验更丰富、状态正佳的年长球员瑞安·克里斯蒂（Ryan Christie）可以出场。但在国际比赛日期间挤入匈牙利首发阵容后，考虑到球队接下来一个月内要进行九场比赛的魔鬼赛程，这位20岁球员获得更多出场时间并被频繁使用也就不足为奇了。巴里·格兰登宁（Barry Glendenning）
切尔西对阵伯恩茅斯，周六下午3点

伊普斯维奇目前处于积分榜中游，总积分为六分，是通过战胜桑德兰和水晶宫取得的。加里·奥尼尔（Gary O'Neil）的球队开局赛程艰难，尽管输给了曼联、利物浦和阿森纳，但他们的主帅并没有让这些失利削弱球队的士气。在主场输给利物浦后接受媒体采访时，奥尼尔展现出了极其乐观的一面，这颠覆了大多数观察家认为比赛从早期阶段就超出其球队能力范围的看法。到目前为止，这是一个成功的策略，与开局未尝胜绩的富勒姆形成了鲜明对比。与奥尼尔一样，阿尔瓦罗·阿韦罗亚（Álvaro Arbeloa）也是新上任。在对阵曼联的平局中表现有所改善，但这并没有带来富勒姆应得的胜利，不过有迹象表明，这位前皇家马德里临时主帅的到来兑现了其提倡的进球和进攻足球的承诺。大部分重担都落在了乔什·金（Josh King）身上，这位少年正在延续去年的突破性赛季。约翰·布鲁温（John Brewin）
伊普斯维奇对阵富勒姆，周六下午3点

桑德兰目前仍留在联赛杯中，还有欧联杯任务要应对，在前五场英超征程中仅获得四分，对于这样一支球队来说，比赛即将接踵而至，他们能否应付如此密集的赛程还有待观察。由于丹·巴拉德（Dan Ballard）和布赖恩·布罗贝（Brian Brobbey）在国际比赛日期间遭遇腿筋受伤，雷吉斯·勒布里斯（Régis Le Bris）在对阵进球如麻的布莱顿阵前将不得不重新排兵布阵。布莱顿此番将进行长达700英里的韦尔赛德往返之旅，这是他们在三周前令人尴尬地输给阿森纳后的首场比赛。威尔逊·伊斯多尔（Wilson Isidor）几乎肯定会替代布罗贝，而巴拉德的中后卫位置将由奥马尔·阿尔德雷特（Omar Alderete）或诺代·穆凯莱（Nordi Mukiele）填补。上一场对阵曼城丢了五球后，桑德兰这条在本赛季初就显得漏洞百出的后防线需要全神贯注，才能阻挡这支已经打入16球的球队的狂飙。BG
桑德兰对阵布莱顿，周六下午3点

如果说“托特纳姆博士”确实存在，那么曼联也拥有为对手疗伤的奇效。自我伤害也是一个因素。他们在揭幕战中向英超新军赫尔城铺红地毯，并让布莱顿重新回到了联赛杯中。在曼联国际比赛日前的最后一场比赛中，疲惫不堪的富勒姆得以重树信心，他们的进球来自于利桑德罗·马丁内斯（Lisandro Martínez）和森内·拉门斯（Senne Lammens）的滑稽防守。老特拉福德的球迷们将庆祝曼城的监管问题，这能否驱散托特纳姆热刺的阴霾？本赛季，就像上赛季和之前的赛季一样，热刺承担起了危机俱乐部的衣钵，迈克尔·卡里克（Michael Carrick）在一月份的到来曾暂时消除了曼联的这种状态。输给托特纳姆热刺，“危机”这个前缀很可能会重新戴上。托特纳姆热刺以前曾造成过破坏。2024年9月，热刺在老特拉福德3-0取胜，开启了埃里克·滕哈赫（Erik ten Hag）走向下课的步伐。输掉欧联杯决赛拉开了鲁本·阿莫林（Ruben Amorim）向下滑落的序幕。卡里克要小心了？JB
曼联对阵托特纳姆热刺，周六下午5:30

所有的目光都将集中在奥利弗·格拉斯纳（Oliver Glasner）身上，他将带着诺丁汉森林重返塞尔赫斯特公园球场，这是一个让双方球迷和董事会都情绪激动的下午。水晶宫主席史蒂夫·帕里什（Steve Parish）上周试图缓和紧张局势，他敦促球迷们“打破常规”，欢迎这位在12个月内带领这家伦敦南部俱乐部夺得队史前三座主要奖杯的主教练。“如果他得到的不是全场沸腾的欢呼，我会感到羞愧难当，”帕里什说。但鉴于对森林及其老板埃万杰洛斯·马里纳基斯（Evangelos Marinakis）的强烈情感——一些人仍然将水晶宫上赛季因森林而降级到欧协联归咎于他——许多人仍然没有原谅格拉斯纳加盟他们的死敌，当这位奥地利教练在开球前坐上教练席时，他们可能仍会表达自己的感受。EA
水晶宫对阵诺丁汉森林，周日下午2点

在塞尔吉·雅基罗维奇（Sergej Jakirovic）和大卫·莫耶斯（David Moyes）的带领下，赫尔城和埃弗顿拥有英超联赛中最具“务用”风格的两名主教练。两支球队都以稳健第一的防守风格闻名，乐于放弃控球权，在顶级联赛传球成功率中排名垫底，并严重依赖快速转换和定位球来获取大部分预期进球。一场由两支以顽强为傲的后防线进行的比赛，很可能会由一个精准传到密集禁区内的死球来决定胜负。虽然它可能不具美感，但预计周日下午双方的大批后防球员大部分时间都会严阵以待，同时仰望天空。这两支球队上次在英超交手时，埃弗顿以4-0轻松取胜。十年过去了，高空球的往来不太可能会呈一面倒的态势。BG
赫尔城对阵埃弗顿，周日下午2点

曼城在最黑暗的阴霾下恢复比赛，他们将造访一个黄金时期最伟大对手的主场，而这一主场如今却被有罪判决所笼罩。在恩佐·马雷斯卡（Enzo Maresca）麾下取得英超五连胜，曾为后佩普·瓜迪奥拉（Pep Guardiola）时代的成功带来希望。对于一家满脑子都是法律问题的俱乐部来说，构成成功的标准已经发生了变化，但演出必须继续。马雷斯卡能唤醒围城心态吗？当100多项指控在2023年首次公开曝光时，曼城曾举起包括欧冠在内的三冠王。安菲尔德的球迷将欣然提醒曼城他们俱乐部面临的耻辱。瓜迪奥拉如今备受争议的统治是以尤尔根·克洛普（Jürgen Klopp）伟大球队为代价换来的，这会火上浇油，很可能会在安菲尔德引发焰火欢迎。在治安和场上都需要保持冷静的头脑，回归专注于足球或许能提供受欢迎的解脱。JB
利物浦对阵曼城，周日下午4:30

国际足球的介入遏制了考文垂在对阵诺丁汉森林比赛中获胜的肾上腺素飙升，杰伊·达席尔瓦（Jay Dasilva）打入了自2001年以来该俱乐部在顶级联赛中的首粒精彩进球。这为弗兰克·兰帕德（Frank Lampard）奠定了基础，提供了一个蓝图，即允许森林自我消耗，随后达席尔瓦通过反击打入进球。18岁的斯蒂芬·姆富尼（Stephen Mfuni）是租借自曼城球员，他在英超首秀的防守努力中大放异彩。考文垂现在正寻求在一个2005年启用、伴随着俱乐部长期衰落开始的球场里打入首个英超进球。纽卡斯尔本周迎来了由沙特阿拉伯公共投资基金（PIF）领导的财团收购五周年。经历了两个赛季的欧冠足球，捧起过一座奖杯，但仍有一种未竟之志的感觉。马蒂亚斯·贾伊斯勒（Matthias Jaissle）正在领导一段断断续续的发展过程的第二阶段，本赛季的积极迹象被对阵利兹联1-4失利等挫折所冲淡，这表明考文垂还有很长的路要走。JB
考文垂对阵纽卡斯尔，周一晚上8点
